scope: Offline evaluator calibration only; no pipeline, benchmark, reference or retrieval modifications
source_review: Original PDF hashes checked for every control; source passages and prior reviewed reference maps compared before declaring labels.
judge_versions: Original RAGAS 0.1.5 Context Precision prompt plus existing strict JSON format contract
Same RAGAS prompt with evidence-grounding instruction appended, requiring verbatim context evidence for positive verdicts
invalid_output_policy: Missing/invalid, never relabeled zero. Quote mismatch is a contract failure, not proof the context is irrelevant.
classification_policy: Useful evidence for at least one requested fact is positive; mere topic/office overlap without requested facts is negative. Partial answers are not penalized as irrelevant.
review_policy: Report FP/FN, format/evidence failures and valid coverage separately by office/language. No automatic promotion or statistical certification based on this small reused development calibration set.
supplemental_engineering_scope: Calibration labels and evidence-quote validator are development diagnostics, not new manuscript performance metrics. Any revised judge must later rescore baseline and candidate with identical settings.
methodology: 20260923.pdf PDF24-25,31-34: offline evaluation, 15-cell Context Precision objective, development-only tuning and freeze before held-out testing.
tracker: Thesis Tracker main tab requirements archived in t06-formal-development-validation-v4/methodology_and_tracker.json; no workbook changes.
